ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Chits uses your microphone only when you choose to record a voice note.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Chits only uses the photos and videos you choose to attach to a note or set as your chat background.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Chits saves a copy of a photo, video or Share Note image to your photo library only when you choose to save it.
